params.1273: Find out about the Rules of Conduct from the town crier in Draynor.
params.1274: Follow the road north out of Lumbridge.
params.1275: Pass the general store, Fred's farm and the wheat fields until you reach a crossroads.
params.1276: At the crossroads, head south into Draynor and west when you reach the bank.
params.1277: The town crier can be found in the marketplace.
params.1292: This Beginner Task is part of the Lumbridge set.
